content: In AIF-47 and AIF-48, missing jsonschema or PyYAML caused import failures that looked like application/test defects. Rerunning with the pinned dependencies passed without application changes. Before debugging a test failure, verify the current Git test command and interpreter environment. On this checkout use uv run --offline --no-project --with jsonschema[format]==4.25.1 --with PyYAML==6.0.2 python -m unittest discover -s tests -q. Native Paperclip checks use the preinstalled /paperclip/m1-python-libs through PYTHONPATH. Promote this repeated lesson into a credential-free deterministic check command; do not install arbitrary packages or treat this historical command as overriding current Git.
